newsitem.title: USA: Redemptions expected to total $230 bln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Redemptions expected to total $230 bln in 1997.

text.p: A total of $230 billion is expected to flow back to municipal debt investors in 1997, down from $294 billion in 1996, according to MuniView/Muller Data Corp.

For 1997, June and July should see the biggest cash spurts, with June's redemptions expected to total $31.9 billion and July's expected to hit $31.3 billion. MuniView's figures are for current and advance refundings, maturing bonds and notes, and coupon payments.
In 1997, January is expected to be the third biggest redemption month at $23 billion, followed by December at $21.5 billion and August at $21 billion, MuniView's figures show.
